content: koehn-knowles:2017:NMT showed that NMT is unable to handle low-resource language pairs as opposed to PBSMT. Transfer learning approaches BIBREF5 , BIBREF6 , BIBREF7 work well when a large helping parallel corpus is available. This restricts one of the source or the target languages to be English which, in our case, is not possible. Approaches involving bi-directional NMT modeling is shown to drastically improve low-resource translation BIBREF11 . However, like most other, this work focuses on translation from and into English.
